description: This file defines a class UnitsComboBoxRenderer which is a custom table cell renderer extending JComboBox and implementing TableCellRenderer for rendering ECU data units in a JTable as a combo box based on LoggerData and EcuDataConvertor.

classes.name: UnitsComboBoxRenderer
classes.description: A custom cell renderer for JTable that displays ECU data units as a combo box based on LoggerData.

methods.name: getTableCellRendererComponent
methods.description: Creates and returns a JComboBox populated with convertors from LoggerData, selecting the current convertor.
